name: Rod of Ages

passives.name: Timeless
passives.effects: This item gains 10 bonus health, 30 bonus mana, and 3 ability power every minute, up to 10 times, for a maximum of 100 bonus health, 300 bonus mana, and 30 ability power. Upon reaching maximum stacks, gain a level that preserves your current experience (level cap remains the same).

passives.name: Eternity
passives.effects: Restore mana equal to 10% of pre-mitigation damage taken from champions, and heal for 0 – 20 (based on mana spent) per cast. Toggled abilities can only heal for up to 20 per second.
